Gitboard serves as a local command center for managing code changes across GitLab and GitHub. It orchestrates local development workflows by aggregating real-time visibility into CI status, open merge requests, and failed job triage. By interfacing with local forge CLIs (`gh`, `glab`) and `git`, the tool provides a unified dashboard to monitor worktree states and streamline the transition from remote repository updates to local execution.
